user.title: Fledge
user.description: Choose the Nest thermostat running Fledge. It has to be connected to Home Assistant over MQTT first.

confirm.title: Fledge
confirm.description: A Nest thermostat running Fledge was found (serial {serial}). Put Home Assistant on its screen?

cards.title: What the thermostat shows
cards.description: Turning the ring moves from the thermostat to these cards: one for each room's lights, then each other thermostat and media player. Change them any time from Configure.

data_description.areas: Each room becomes a lights card with the room's lights.
data_description.climates: Heating zones or other thermostats to set from this one.
data_description.media: Speakers whose volume the ring sets.
data_description.exclude: Lights in those rooms not to list, such as a screen's backlight.

wake.title: When the thermostat wakes
wake.description: What a turn or press shows when the thermostat's screen is dark. The device chooser shows the thermostat among your devices, zoomed out: turn to browse, press to open. Or open one device straight away.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already set up.
abort.no_thermostats: No Nest running Fledge was found. Connect it to Home Assistant over MQTT first.
abort.not_fledge: This isn't a thermostat running Fledge.
